items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Topics 92:1
items.html: The first aspect of the soul of Adam HaRishon, which is the Nefesh in Keter, resembles the first division of Nekudim, which is the three heads that came out there during Katnut. For the three heads are three Ketarim, as is known, since every Rosh is a Keter, and from them only the aspects of Nefesh and Ruach emerged, meaning the Katnut within Keter. And the second aspect of Adam HaRishon, which is the completion of NRNHY of Keter, resembles the second division of Nekudim, which is from the aspect of the new light that shone through the Tabur of AK, and brought down the bottom Hey from the Einayim of Keter, and returned Aba ve Ima to the aspect of Rosh and GAR — for then the heads attained the aspects of GAR within them, namely NRNHY of Keter, since at that stage only the heads themselves had come out, and not yet the Toch and Sof, which are their bodies. And the third aspect of the soul of Adam HaRishon, which is the aspect of the ten lower, all-encompassing Sefirot of his soul, resembles the third division of Nekudim, which are the Mochin that came out through the illumination of the MAN of Vav and a dot, when the bodies of each of the heads came out — namely the ZAT of Nekudim, which reigned and expanded down to the point of this world. (Inner Light, page 683, Sub Header, “And You Shall Comprehend”)
